paragraphs.cn: 在科学发现赛道上，AI正在成为研究人员的「超级助手」。DeepMind的AlphaFold 3将蛋白质结构预测扩展到几乎所有的生物分子。AI在材料科学中发现了新催化剂和新超导材料候选。在数学领域，AI系统开始协助证明长期未解决的猜想。在药物发现中，AI将候选药物的筛选时间从数年缩短到数月。
paragraphs.en: In the scientific discovery track, AI is becoming a "super assistant" for researchers. DeepMind's AlphaFold 3 has extended protein structure prediction to nearly all biological molecules. AI has discovered new catalysts and candidate superconducting materials in materials science. In mathematics, AI systems are beginning to help prove long-standing conjectures. In drug discovery, AI has reduced candidate drug screening time from years to months.

paragraphs.cn: 开源生态的蓬勃发展是2026年AI领域最令人鼓舞的趋势之一。Llama 4、DeepSeek V4、Qwen 3和Mistral系列等开源模型在能力和效率上持续追赶闭源前沿，为企业提供了灵活且经济的选择。选择正确的AI模型需要理解几个关键维度：任务类型、部署约束、成本预算和安全合规要求。在这个多元竞争的时代，理解选择的权衡，比选择本身更加重要。
paragraphs.en: The thriving open-source ecosystem is one of the most encouraging trends in AI in 2026. Open-source models like Llama 4, DeepSeek V4, Qwen 3, and the Mistral series continue to close the gap with closed-source frontiers in capability and efficiency, offering enterprises flexible and cost-effective alternatives. Choosing the right AI model requires understanding several key dimensions: task type, deployment constraints, cost budget, and security compliance requirements. In this era of multi-dimensional competition, understanding the trade-offs matters more than the choice itself.

paragraphs.cn: 在代码与自动化赛道上，AI编码已经从辅助工具进化为核心开发引擎。GitHub Copilot、Cursor和Claude Code等工具使得42%的新代码包含AI辅助生成的成分。SWE-bench基准测试显示，领先的AI编码Agent已经能够独立解决约70-80%的真实GitHub问题。但编码AI的竞争不仅在准确性上，更在于对项目上下文的理解深度、多文件协调能力和自主调试能力。Claude 4.5 Sonnet以70.6%的SWE-bench得分领先，展示了专门的编码能力。
paragraphs.en: In the code and automation track, AI coding has evolved from an assistive tool into a core development engine. Tools like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and Claude Code now contribute to 42% of all new code. The SWE-bench benchmark shows that leading AI coding agents can independently resolve about 70-80% of real GitHub issues. But the competition in coding AI isn't just about accuracy -- it's about depth of project context understanding, multi-file coordination, and autonomous debugging. Claude 4.5 Sonnet leads with a 70.6% SWE-bench score, demonstrating specialized coding capability.

paragraphs.cn: 在创意生成赛道上，图像、视频和音频生成模型的质量突飞猛进。Midjourney v7在艺术视觉方面保持领先，Google Imagen 4在照片级真实感上表现出色。Sora和Runway Gen-3使AI视频生成从实验走向实用，支持从文本描述生成连贯的视频内容。这些进步正在重新定义创意产业的边界。
paragraphs.en: In the creative generation track, the quality of image, video, and audio generation models has advanced dramatically. Midjourney v7 maintains its lead in artistic visuals, while Google Imagen 4 excels in photorealistic fidelity. Sora and Runway Gen-3 have moved AI video generation from experimentation to practicality, supporting coherent video content generated from text descriptions. These advances are redefining the boundaries of the creative industry.

paragraphs.cn: 在科学发现赛道上，AI正在成为研究人员的「超级助手」。DeepMind的AlphaFold 3将蛋白质结构预测扩展到几乎所有的生物分子，提供了至少50%的改进。GNoME发现了38万个新的稳定材料候选。这些「发现引擎」与GPT-5等「知识引擎」形成了鲜明对比——前者创造新知识，后者重组现有知识。
paragraphs.en: In the scientific discovery track, AI is becoming a "super assistant" for researchers. DeepMind's AlphaFold 3 has extended protein structure prediction to nearly all biological molecules, delivering at least a 50% improvement. GNoME has discovered 380,000 new candidate stable materials. These "discovery engines" contrast sharply with "knowledge engines" like GPT-5 -- the former creates new knowledge, while the latter recombines existing knowledge.

paragraphs.cn: 从技术架构角度看，2026年有几个关键趋势值得关注。检索增强生成（RAG）是最经济高效的方法，通过将外部知识库的检索结果注入提示来增强LLM的能力。混合专家（MoE）架构是另一个关键创新——它允许模型拥有大量总参数但只激活其中一小部分，大幅提升了训练和推理效率。Kimi K2的万亿参数和Llama 4的1000万token上下文窗口都展示了这种架构的威力。
paragraphs.en: From a technical architecture perspective, several key trends in 2026 are worth watching. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is the most cost-effective approach, enhancing LLM capabilities by injecting retrieval results from external knowledge bases into prompts. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture is another critical innovation -- it allows models to have a large total parameter count while only activating a small fraction at a time, significantly improving training and inference efficiency. Kimi K2's trillion parameters and Llama 4's 10-million-token context window both showcase the power of this architecture.

paragraphs.cn: 选择正确的AI模型需要理解几个关键维度：任务类型、部署约束、成本预算和安全合规要求。在这个多元竞争的时代，理解选择的权衡，比选择本身更加重要。现代开发者的核心技能不再是使用单一模型，而是系统架构能力——正确识别问题，选择专精模型，并将其整合为高效、经济的系统。
paragraphs.en: Choosing the right AI model requires understanding several key dimensions: task type, deployment constraints, cost budget, and security compliance requirements. In this era of multi-dimensional competition, understanding the trade-offs matters more than the choice itself. The core skill for modern developers is no longer using a single model but rather systems architecture -- correctly identifying problems, selecting specialized models, and integrating them into efficient, cost-effective systems.

paragraphs.cn: 概念一：检索增强生成（RAG）是最经济高效的方法，通过将外部知识库的检索结果注入提示来增强LLM的能力。RAG的工作流程分为四个步骤：查询——用户提出问题；检索——查询被发送到检索器，在向量数据库中搜索最相关的文档片段；增强——将检索到的片段注入用户的提示中；生成——LLM使用增强后的提示生成有事实依据的回答。这种方法使AI系统能够利用实时数据和私有知识库，而无需进行昂贵的完整模型重训练。
paragraphs.en: Concept 1: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is the most cost-effective approach, enhancing LLM capabilities by injecting retrieval results from external knowledge bases into prompts. The RAG workflow has four steps: Query -- the user asks a question; Retrieval -- the query is sent to a retriever that searches a vector database for the most relevant document fragments; Augmentation -- the retrieved fragments are injected into the user's prompt; Generation -- the LLM uses the augmented prompt to produce a fact-grounded response. This approach enables AI systems to leverage real-time data and private knowledge bases without expensive full model retraining.

paragraphs.cn: 概念二：Transformer与混合专家（MoE）是2026年最关键的架构创新。传统的密集Transformer在处理每个token时都会激活所有参数，计算开销巨大。MoE模型用「稀疏」层替换单一的FFN层——包含一个「门控网络」（路由器）和多个小型「专家」。当token到达时，路由器只将它发送给少数几个专家。结果是模型可以拥有巨大的总参数量（如Kimi K2的万亿参数），但每次推理只使用其中的一小部分。这使得训练和推理的速度和效率大幅提升。
paragraphs.en: Concept 2: Transformers and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) are the most critical architectural innovations of 2026. Traditional dense Transformers activate all parameters for every token, creating enormous computational overhead. MoE models replace the single FFN layer with "sparse" layers -- containing a "gating network" (router) and multiple small "experts." When a token arrives, the router sends it to only a few experts. The result is that a model can have a massive total parameter count (such as Kimi K2's trillion parameters) while using only a small fraction per inference. This dramatically improves both training and inference speed and efficiency.

paragraphs.cn: 概念三：混合Transformer-Mamba（Hymba）是架构的下一个进化方向，专为最大推理效率而设计。NVIDIA的Nemotron模型采用了这种架构，将大部分自注意力层替换为Mamba层，只保留足够的注意力头用于高分辨率回忆，同时使用高效的Mamba层进行上下文摘要。结果是「同等准确度」下推理速度提升「最高3倍」。
paragraphs.en: Concept 3: The hybrid Transformer-Mamba (Hymba) architecture represents the next evolutionary direction, designed for maximum inference efficiency. NVIDIA's Nemotron model adopts this architecture, replacing most self-attention layers with Mamba layers while retaining just enough attention heads for high-resolution recall, and using efficient Mamba layers for context summarization. The result is "up to 3x" inference speedup at "equivalent accuracy."

paragraphs.cn: 成本效益分析揭示了2026年AI竞争的另一个维度。Claude 4.5 Sonnet以每任务0.56美元的成本获得70.6%的SWE-bench得分，而GPT-5 mini以仅0.04美元的成本获得59.8%的得分。这使「最佳」模型变成了一个生产级的成本效益分析问题。创业公司的最佳选择可能是「足够好」的最便宜模型——这推动了智能路由器的兴起，先用便宜模型处理，只在任务失败时才升级到昂贵的高性能模型。现代开发者的核心技能不再是使用单一模型，而是系统架构能力——正确识别问题，选择专精模型，并将其整合为高效、经济的系统。
paragraphs.en: Cost-effectiveness analysis reveals another dimension of the 2026 AI competition. Claude 4.5 Sonnet achieves a 70.6% SWE-bench score at $0.56 per task, while GPT-5 mini achieves 59.8% at only $0.04 per task. This turns the "best" model into a production-grade cost-effectiveness question. The optimal choice for startups may be the cheapest model that is "good enough" -- driving the rise of intelligent routers that start with cheap models and only escalate to expensive high-performance models when a task fails. The core skill for modern developers is no longer using a single model but rather systems architecture -- correctly identifying problems, selecting specialized models, and integrating them into efficient, cost-effective systems.

paragraphs.cn: 概念四：宪法AI（CAI）是Anthropic的核心对齐技术。它通过两阶段的自纠正过程来构建安全、有用且诚实的AI系统。在监督阶段，AI被赋予一组「宪法」原则，然后被要求根据这些原则来批评和重写自己的回答。这些自纠正的数据被用于微调模型。在强化学习阶段，过程重复进行，训练一个偏好模型来为标准微调提供奖励信号。结果是AI系统对齐于一组明确的、可审查的原则，带来了Claude 4.5所展示的「显著改善的安全性能」。
paragraphs.en: Concept 4: Constitutional AI (CAI) is Anthropic's core alignment technology. It builds safe, helpful, and honest AI systems through a two-stage self-correction process. In the supervised stage, the AI is given a set of "constitutional" principles and is then asked to critique and revise its own responses based on those principles. This self-corrected data is used to fine-tune the model. In the reinforcement learning stage, the process repeats, training a preference model to provide reward signals for standard fine-tuning. The result is an AI system aligned with an explicit, auditable set of principles, yielding the "significantly improved safety performance" demonstrated by Claude 4.5.

paragraphs.cn: 2026年AI竞赛的结论是：不存在单一的赢家，而是一个专业系统的组合。顶级性能的差距如此之小，以至于「最佳」模型不再是一个简单的「谁」，而是一个「哪个」——哪个模型是为你的特定任务而设计的？对于通用对话和人类偏好，Google Gemini 2.5 Pro领先；对于自主编码和bug修复，Claude 4.5 Sonnet是冠军；对于长上下文数据处理，Meta的Llama 4 Scout以1000万token上下文窗口改变了游戏规则。最终，「AI竞赛」的胜利者将是那些能够正确识别问题、选择专精模型并将其整合为高效系统的人。
paragraphs.en: The conclusion of the 2026 AI race is that there is no single winner, but rather a portfolio of specialized systems. The gap at the top is so narrow that the "best" model is no longer a simple "who" but a "which" -- which model is designed for your specific task? For general conversation and human preference, Google Gemini 2.5 Pro leads; for autonomous coding and bug fixing, Claude 4.5 Sonnet is the champion; for long-context data processing, Meta's Llama 4 Scout changes the game with its 10-million-token context window. Ultimately, the winners of the "AI race" will be those who can correctly identify problems, select specialized models, and integrate them into efficient systems.

paragraphs.cn: 开源世界的崛起也是这一格局的重要组成部分。虽然闭源模型在能力上仍有优势，但Meta的Llama 4 Scout以1000万token上下文窗口这样的突破性特性，使大规模数据分析不再局限于昂贵的闭源API。Moonshot的Kimi K2作为中国顶尖AI竞争力的代表，在Tau2 Bench电信智能体基准上排名第一，证明了AI竞争已不再局限于美国。这种全球化竞争的格局正在加速AI技术的整体进步。
paragraphs.en: The rise of the open-source world is also an important part of this landscape. While closed-source models still hold an edge in capability, Meta's Llama 4 Scout -- with breakthrough features like a 10-million-token context window -- makes large-scale data analysis no longer limited to expensive closed-source APIs. Moonshot's Kimi K2, representing China's top AI competitiveness, ranked first on the Tau2 Bench telecommunications agent benchmark, proving that AI competition is no longer confined to the United States. This globally competitive landscape is accelerating the overall progress of AI technology.

articles.title: Agentic AI 的架构设计与自主性边界
articles.subtitle: 智能体AI的架构模式：自主性、工具使用与安全防护
articles.author: Anthropic Research / AI Safety Team
articles.summary: 随着AI Agent在复杂任务中的自主性不断提升，如何在保持效能的同时为其设立安全边界成为核心议题。本文探讨了Agent系统的三层架构：工具调用层、推理规划层与价值对齐层，以及如何实现最小权限自主性原则。
articles.content_cn:
构建智能体的架构：目的、范围与可靠性
Nowaczyk | 哈尔姆斯塔德大学
1 引言：目的、范围与架构可靠性
本章探讨构建智能体AI系统的架构选择，并分析这些选择如何影响可靠性。我们的核心主张简单明了：可靠性首先是一种架构属性。它源于我们将系统分解为组件的方式、界面的规范与执行方式，以及在负责推理、记忆和行动的各部分周围嵌入控制与保障环的方式。单个模型固然重要，但如果没有恰当的架构支撑，即使是最先进的模型也会表现不一致、无法审计，并在 novelty 面前显得脆弱。
本语境下的智能体AI，指的是系统通过决定下一步做什么、选择和使用工具、查阅和更新记忆，以及在约束条件下与环境交互来追求长期目标。智能体不仅仅是一个预测器；它是一个闭环中的决策者。它观察、规划（至少是选择）、行动和学习，通常在不确定性和部分可观测性下进行。
生成式AI指的是合成内容（文本、代码、图像、计划或中间表示）的模型——通常作为智能体内部的推理底层，或提供其他组件执行或验证的产物（查询、程序、模拟、解释）。在现代系统中，生成模型提供策略（如何推理和提出行动建议），而智能体架构则提供机制（建议如何被验证、制定、约束和记录）。
理解智能体生成式AI与传统自主智能体的关系至关重要，可以避免重复造轮子：许多关键概念已被长期研究并相对成熟；然而，生成式AI的本质也带来了全新的挑战，需要重新审视曾经的定论。
传统的反应式、审慎式或BDI（信念-欲望-意图）架构为信念、目标、计划和意图等概念提供了理论基础和清晰定义，具有清晰的控制环和显式世界模型。现代智能体系统通常用神经网络基础模型取代手工设计的推理模块。这些在大规模多样数据上训练的模型极大地提高了灵活性和能力广度，但也引入了推理步骤和工具使用方面的不确定性。
本章保留经典观点的有用约束——显式状态、目标、计划、承诺策略和监控——同时承认管道的某些部分（如计划生成或假设形成）可能由生成模型实现。这种协调正是架构发挥价值之处。
我们所说的可靠性，是指在规定条件下持续达成预期成果，并保持在安全、安保、数据保护和资源使用的可接受范围内，且有证据表明故障模式已知、受控且可恢复。对于智能体AI而言，这远不止模型准确性，还包括正确的工具调用、有边界的行动序列、对操纵的抵抗、可预测的延迟和成本，以及 graceful degradation、审计能力和人工覆盖路径。
架构通过以下方式使这些属性变得可处理：（i）在其契约可推理的模块中隔离职责；（ii）在推理与行动之间插入验证器和核查器；（iii）通过授权工具接口约束权威性和副作用；以及（iv）为系统配备仪表，使内部状态、决策和结果可观测且可重放。
在实践中，三个相互加强的设计选择决定了智能体系统在压力下的行为。组件化：将感知、记忆、规划、工具路由、执行、验证和监督等功能分离，将故障限制在明确界定的边界内，并限制其影响范围。接口与契约：将自由形式的模型输出转换为可预测的、可审计的行动。控制与保障环：监控器将计划行为与观察行为进行比较，批评者和验证器核查事实性和安全不变性，监督者执行预算和终止标准。
2 经典理论基础
2.1 反应式、审慎式与混合架构
反应式架构通过手工编码的条件-动作规则或学习策略将感知直接映射到行动。其优势是低延迟和对轻微分布偏移的鲁棒性；其劣势是在需要 lookahead、长期信用分配或对隐藏状态推理的任务面前表现脆弱。典型故障包括：短视反应（缺乏显式规划）、部分可观测性和未建模延迟。
审慎式架构维护世界的显式模型，并使用搜索或规划来选择行动。它们在可解释性和目标一致性方面表现出色，但可能遭受延迟和模型不匹配的困扰。典型故障包括：过时计划在快速变化的环境中变得不合适、模型不完备和计算超时。
混合架构将两种方法相结合：反应式层处理紧密控制环，审慎式层提供目标、约束和重规划。混合架构仍然是最实用的智能体AI模板，因为它们分离了关注点：需要行动的地方有快速安全，需要推理的地方有慢速监督层。故障通常源于层之间的协调缺陷，而非某一层单独的问题。
2.2 信念-欲望-意图（BDI）模型
BDI将代理框架为对信念（信息状态）、欲望（允许的目标）和意图（已采纳的计划/承诺）的管理。两个观点使BDI经久不衰：承诺策略（智能体在条件成立时坚持意图，因为承诺创造可预测性并减少颠簸）和意图修订（当触发条件或上下文改变时，智能体重新考虑意图并可能放弃、暂停或替换意图）。
映射到现代生成式AI智能体：信念→世界状态和记忆；欲望→目标和约束；意图→活跃计划和工具调用。BDI还阐明了将保障层置于何处的依据：采纳过滤器决定候选目标何时成为意图；执行监控跟踪上下文是否仍然支持该意图；重规划策略规定智能体重新规划的频率和信号。
3 现代智能体架构分类
现代智能体系统不是单一的整体设计，而是不同构建块——规划环、工具路由器、记忆层、验证器和监督者——围绕生成式推理核心的组合。五类架构在实践中反复出现。
3.1 工具使用型智能体
工具使用型智能体让生成模型决定调用哪些外部能力、用什么参数、按什么顺序来完成目标。三个关键角色：规划器生成意图结构（子目标、假设、候选行动）；工具路由器将抽象行动映射到具体工具；执行沙箱执行前提条件检查，对每次调用进行速率限制和授权，在可能的情况下进行模拟，并以事务性方式（或回滚）提交副作用。
关键工程选择：类型化模式和验证器（将每次工具调用视为契约，拒绝不匹配，结构化错误反馈）；幂等工具和请求去重（副作用工具应接受幂等令牌，安全重试）；基于能力的授权（最小权限绑定工具，per-call政策核查）；事务语义和补偿（当ACID不可用时使用saga模式）；预算和终止标准（执行步数上限、累计成本上限和墙上时钟超时）；确定性可观测性（以结构化形式记录计划、工具参数、结果和决策理由）。
典型故障模式和缓解：幻觉工具或参数可通过允许列表、模式验证和路由器批准来应对；无限或不生产的循环通过步数上限和安全停止来约束；工具不稳定需要"设计用于重试"思维和断路器；提示或检索注入需要消毒工具输出，剥离控制令牌，将任何不受信任的文本视为数据而非指令。核心原则：模型提议，架构处置。
3.2 记忆增强型智能体
智能体系统在能够记忆时会显著变得更加能干。工作记忆是episode内短暂存在的上下文（草稿本、CoT痕迹）；长期记忆分为情景存储（先前任务的Structured日志）和语义存储（文档、事实）。检索增强生成（RAG）提供了进入语义记忆的非参数路径。
为可靠性而设计记忆需要：溯源与归属（每个检索或持久化的条目应携带源标识符、内容哈希、时间戳和检索政策/版本）；新鲜度和有效期限（引入按来源的TTL和访问时刷新政策）；记忆卫生与污染防御（将所有不受信任的文本视为数据而非指令）；压缩、摘要与保留策略（冷存储保留无损Structured日志，中期召回保留摘要热存以便快速访问）。
3.3 规划与自我改进型智能体
规划型智能体通过显式搜索、外部执行器和自我评估环来加强模型的原始推理。思维树（ToT）将推理组织为对中间思想的搜索，而非单一从左到右的传递，使智能体能够从早期局部错误中恢复。思维图（GoT）将其推广到任意依赖图，允许子图的重组、摘要或优化。程序辅助语言模型（PAL）将推理转向可执行程序，由外部运行时执行，产生精确、确定性的计算。反思（Reflexion）在推理时增加自我评估和测试时修复，将反馈转化为结构化指导。
3.4 多智能体系统
多智能体系统用一组专业智能体团队取代单一全能智能体。三种拓扑：监督器-工作者（协调者负责任务分解和分配，权威和升级路径清晰）；对等协作（协议规则驱动收敛）；角色专业智能体（拍卖和黑板系统）。核心原则：模型提议，架构处置——通过将开放式推理转换为可靠行动的契约、调控器和沙箱。

Chapter 3: Architectures for Building Agentic AI
Slawomir Nowaczyk
1 Introduction: Purpose, Scope, and Architecture Reliability
This chapter surveys architectural choices for building agentic AI systems and analyses how those choices shape reliability. Our central claim is straightforward: reliability is, first and foremost, an architectural property. It emerges from how we decompose a system into components, how we specify and enforce interfaces between them, and how we embed control and assurance loops around the parts that reason, remember, and act.
Individual models matter, but without the right architectural scaffolding, even state-of-the-art models will behave inconsistently, be impossible to audit, and prove fragile in the face of novelty.
Agentic AI in this book denotes systems that pursue goals over time by deciding what to do next, selecting and using tools, consulting and updating memory, and interacting with their environment under constraints. An agent is not merely a predictor; it is a decision-maker in a closed loop. It observes, plans (or at least chooses), acts, and learns, typically under uncertainty and partial observability.
Generative AI refers to models that synthesise content—text, code, images, plans, or intermediate representations—often serving as the reasoning substrate inside the agent, or providing artefacts (queries, programs, simulations, explanations) that other components execute or verify. In modern systems, generative models supply the policy (how to reason and propose actions), while the agentic architecture supplies the machinery (how proposals are validated, enacted, bounded, and recorded).
Understanding the relation of Agentic GenAI with classic autonomous agents is crucially important to avoid reinventing the wheel: many key concepts have been studied for a long time and are relatively well-understood today; however, the nature of GenAI also brings up challenges that are completely novel and require rethinking of what was believed to be known.
Traditional reactive, deliberative, or BDI (belief-desire-intention) architectures offer theoretically-founded and crisp notions of concepts such as beliefs, goals, plans, and intentions, with clear control loops and explicit world models. Modern agentic systems often replace hand-engineered reasoning with neural-network-based foundation models. These models, trained on huge amounts of diverse data, vastly increase the flexibility and breadth of competence, but also introduce uncertainty in reasoning steps and tool usage.
By reliability, we mean the consistent achievement of intended outcomes under stated conditions, within acceptable bounds of safety, security, data protection, and resource usage, and with evidence that failure modes are known, contained, and recoverable. For agentic AI, this encompasses much more than just model accuracy. It includes correct tool invocation, bounded action sequences, resistance to manipulation, predictable latency and cost, graceful degradation, auditability, and human-override paths.
Architectures make these properties tractable by: (i) isolating responsibilities in modules whose contracts we can reason about; (ii) interposing validators and verifiers between reasoning and action; (iii) constraining authority and side-effects through permissioned tool interfaces; and (iv) instrumenting the system so that internal state, decisions, and outcomes are observable and replayable.
Three mutually reinforcing design choices determine how agentic systems behave under stress:
Componentisation: Separating functionality such as perception, memory, planning, tool routing, execution, verification, and oversight confines faults to well-defined boundaries and limits their blast radius. Clear responsibilities make defects diagnosable and upgrades safe: a verifier can be strengthened without disturbing the planner; an execution gateway can be hardened without touching memory logic.
Interfaces and contracts: Primary means to tame open-ended model behaviour are typed and schema-validated messages; explicit capability scopes for tools; idempotent and (where feasible) transactional semantics; rate/authority limits. All of these convert free-form model outputs into predictable, auditable actions.
Control and assurance loops: Monitors compare planned with observed behaviour; critics and verifiers check factuality, policy compliance, and safety invariants; supervisors enforce budgets, escalation rules, and termination criteria; fallbacks provide safe modes of operation when assumptions fail.
2 Classical Foundations
2.1 Reactive, Deliberative, and Hybrid Architectures
Reactive architectures map perceptions directly to actions through hand-coded condition–action rules or learned policies. Their strength is low latency and robustness to minor distributional shifts; their weakness is brittleness when tasks require look-ahead, long-horizon credit assignment, or reasoning about hidden state. Typical failure modes include myopic responses (lack of explicit planning), partial observability, and unmodelled delays.
Deliberative architectures maintain explicit models of the world and use search or planning to choose actions. They excel at explainability and goal consistency but can suffer from latency and model mismatch. Typical failures include stale plans, model incompleteness, and computational overrun.
Hybrid architectures combine the two approaches: reactive layers handle tight control loops, while deliberative layers provide goals, constraints, and re-planning. Hybrids remain the most practical template for agentic AI because they separate concerns: fast safety where the action is; slow reasoning in supervisory layers.
2.2 Belief–Desire–Intention (BDI) Architecture
BDI frames agency as the management of Beliefs (informational state), Desires (admissible goals), and Intentions (adopted plans/commitments). Two ideas make BDI enduring: commitment strategies (agents stick to intentions while conditions hold, creating predictability) and intention revision (when context changes, agents reconsider and may drop or replace intentions).
Mapping to modern GenAI agents is straightforward: Beliefs → world state and memory; Desires → goals and constraints; Intentions → active plans and tool calls. BDI clarifies where to place assurance: adoption filters decide when a goal becomes an intention; execution monitors track whether context still supports the intention; reconsideration policies specify how often and under what signals the agent re-plans.
3 A Taxonomy of Modern Agentic Architectures
Modern agentic systems are not single, monolithic designs, but compositions of different building blocks—planning loops, tool routers, memory layers, verifiers, and supervisors—typically stitched together around a core of generative reasoning.
Five families recur in practice:
3.1 Tool-Using Agents
Tool-using agents place a generative model in charge of deciding which external capabilities to invoke, with what arguments, and in what order, to accomplish a goal. A robust implementation separates three concerns: Planners generate intentional structure; Tool routers map abstract actions to concrete tools; Execution sandboxes perform pre-condition checks, rate-limit and permission each call, simulate where possible, and commit side-effects transactionally.
Key engineering choices: Typed schemas and validators; idempotent tools and request deduplication; capability-based permissioning; transactional semantics and compensations; budgets and termination criteria; deterministic observability.
3.2 Memory-Augmented Agents
Agentic systems become markedly more capable when they can remember. Working memory is a short-lived context (scratchpads, CoT traces); long-term memory splits into episodic stores (structured logs of prior tasks) and semantic stores (documents, facts). Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) provides a non-parametric pathway into semantic memory.
Designing memory for reliability requires: Provenance and attribution (every retrieved item should carry source identifiers, content hash, timestamp); Freshness and validity windows (time-to-live policies by source); Memory hygiene and poisoning defences (sanitise all untrusted text); Compaction, summarisation, and retention policies.
3.3 Planning and Self-Improvement Agents
Planning-centred agents strengthen reasoning with explicit search, external executors, and self-evaluation loops. Tree of Thoughts (ToT) organises inference as a search over intermediate thoughts; Graph of Thoughts (GoT) generalises to arbitrary dependency graphs; Program-Aided Language models (PAL) shift reasoning to executable programs; Reflexion adds self-evaluation and test-time repair without gradient updates.
3.4 Multi-Agent Systems
Multi-agent systems exchange a single "do-everything" agent for a team of specialised agents that co-operate under explicit protocols. Three topologies have emerged: Supervisor–worker (clear authority and escalation paths); Peer collaboration (protocol rules drive convergence); Role-specialised agents (auctions and blackboard systems).
The guiding principle across all patterns: models propose, architectures dispose—with contracts, governors, and sandboxes that convert open-ended reasoning into reliable action.

构建智能体的架构：目的、范围与可靠性
Nowaczyk | 哈尔姆斯塔德大学
1 引言：目的、范围与架构可靠性
本章探讨构建智能体AI系统的架构选择，并分析这些选择如何影响可靠性。我们的核心主张简单明了：可靠性首先是一种架构属性。它源于我们将系统分解为组件的方式、界面的规范与执行方式，以及在负责推理、记忆和行动的各部分周围嵌入控制与保障环的方式。单个模型固然重要，但如果没有恰当的架构支撑，即使是最先进的模型也会表现不一致、无法审计，并在 novelty 面前显得脆弱。
本语境下的智能体AI，指的是系统通过决定下一步做什么、选择和使用工具、查阅和更新记忆，以及在约束条件下与环境交互来追求长期目标。智能体不仅仅是一个预测器；它是一个闭环中的决策者。它观察、规划（至少是选择）、行动和学习，通常在不确定性和部分可观测性下进行。
生成式AI指的是合成内容（文本、代码、图像、计划或中间表示）的模型——通常作为智能体内部的推理底层，或提供其他组件执行或验证的产物（查询、程序、模拟、解释）。在现代系统中，生成模型提供策略（如何推理和提出行动建议），而智能体架构则提供机制（建议如何被验证、制定、约束和记录）。
理解智能体生成式AI与传统自主智能体的关系至关重要，可以避免重复造轮子：许多关键概念已被长期研究并相对成熟；然而，生成式AI的本质也带来了全新的挑战，需要重新审视曾经的定论。
传统的反应式、审慎式或BDI（信念-欲望-意图）架构为信念、目标、计划和意图等概念提供了理论基础和清晰定义，具有清晰的控制环和显式世界模型。现代智能体系统通常用神经网络基础模型取代手工设计的推理模块。这些在大规模多样数据上训练的模型极大地提高了灵活性和能力广度，但也引入了推理步骤和工具使用方面的不确定性。
本章保留经典观点的有用约束——显式状态、目标、计划、承诺策略和监控——同时承认管道的某些部分（如计划生成或假设形成）可能由生成模型实现。这种协调正是架构发挥价值之处。
我们所说的可靠性，是指在规定条件下持续达成预期成果，并保持在安全、安保、数据保护和资源使用的可接受范围内，且有证据表明故障模式已知、受控且可恢复。对于智能体AI而言，这远不止模型准确性，还包括正确的工具调用、有边界的行动序列、对操纵的抵抗、可预测的延迟和成本，以及 graceful degradation、审计能力和人工覆盖路径。
架构通过以下方式使这些属性变得可处理：（i）在其契约可推理的模块中隔离职责；（ii）在推理与行动之间插入验证器和核查器；（iii）通过授权工具接口约束权威性和副作用；以及（iv）为系统配备仪表，使内部状态、决策和结果可观测且可重放。
在实践中，三个相互加强的设计选择决定了智能体系统在压力下的行为。组件化：将感知、记忆、规划、工具路由、执行、验证和监督等功能分离，将故障限制在明确界定的边界内，并限制其影响范围。接口与契约：将自由形式的模型输出转换为可预测的、可审计的行动。控制与保障环：监控器将计划行为与观察行为进行比较，批评者和验证器核查事实性和安全不变性，监督者执行预算和终止标准。
2 经典理论基础
2.1 反应式、审慎式与混合架构
反应式架构通过手工编码的条件-动作规则或学习策略将感知直接映射到行动。其优势是低延迟和对轻微分布偏移的鲁棒性；其劣势是在需要 lookahead、长期信用分配或对隐藏状态推理的任务面前表现脆弱。典型故障包括：短视反应（缺乏显式规划）、部分可观测性和未建模延迟。
审慎式架构维护世界的显式模型，并使用搜索或规划来选择行动。它们在可解释性和目标一致性方面表现出色，但可能遭受延迟和模型不匹配的困扰。典型故障包括：过时计划在快速变化的环境中变得不合适、模型不完备和计算超时。
混合架构将两种方法相结合：反应式层处理紧密控制环，审慎式层提供目标、约束和重规划。混合架构仍然是最实用的智能体AI模板，因为它们分离了关注点：需要行动的地方有快速安全，需要推理的地方有慢速监督层。故障通常源于层之间的协调缺陷，而非某一层单独的问题。
2.2 信念-欲望-意图（BDI）模型
BDI将代理框架为对信念（信息状态）、欲望（允许的目标）和意图（已采纳的计划/承诺）的管理。两个观点使BDI经久不衰：承诺策略（智能体在条件成立时坚持意图，因为承诺创造可预测性并减少颠簸）和意图修订（当触发条件或上下文改变时，智能体重新考虑意图并可能放弃、暂停或替换意图）。

Modern agentic systems often replace hand-engineered reasoning with neural-network-based foundation models. These models, trained on huge amounts of diverse data, vastly increase the flexibility and breadth of competence, but also introduce uncertainty in reasoning steps and tool usage.

By reliability, we mean the consistent achievement of intended outcomes under stated conditions, within acceptable bounds of safety, security, data protection, and resource usage, and with evidence that failure modes are known, contained, and recoverable. For agentic AI, this encompasses much more than just model accuracy. It includes correct tool invocation, bounded action sequences, resistance to manipulation, predictable latency and cost, graceful degradation, auditability, and human-override paths.

Architectures make these properties tractable by: (i) isolating responsibilities in modules whose contracts we can reason about; (ii) interposing validators and verifiers between reasoning and action; (iii) constraining authority and side-effects through permissioned tool interfaces; and (iv) instrumenting the system so that internal state, decisions, and outcomes are observable and replayable.

Three mutually reinforcing design choices determine how agentic systems behave under stress:

Componentisation: Separating functionality such as perception, memory, planning, tool routing, execution, verification, and oversight confines faults to well-defined boundaries and limits their blast radius. Clear responsibilities make defects diagnosable and upgrades safe: a verifier can be strengthened without disturbing the planner; an execution gateway can be hardened without touching memory logic.

Interfaces and contracts: Primary means to tame open-ended model behaviour are typed and schema-validated messages; explicit capability scopes for tools; idempotent and (where feasible) transactional semantics; rate/authority limits. All of these convert free-form model outputs into predictable, auditable actions.

Control and assurance loops: Monitors compare planned with observed behaviour; critics and verifiers check factuality, policy compliance, and safety invariants; supervisors enforce budgets, escalation rules, and termination criteria; fallbacks provide safe modes of operation when assumptions fail.

2 Classical Foundations

2.1 Reactive, Deliberative, and Hybrid Architectures

Reactive architectures map perceptions directly to actions through hand-coded condition–action rules or learned policies. Their strength is low latency and robustness to minor distributional shifts; their weakness is brittleness when tasks require look-ahead, long-horizon credit assignment, or reasoning about hidden state. Typical failure modes include myopic responses (lack of explicit planning), partial observability, and unmodelled delays.

Deliberative architectures maintain explicit models of the world and use search or planning to choose actions. They excel at explainability and goal consistency but can suffer from latency and model mismatch. Typical failures include stale plans, model incompleteness, and computational overrun.

Hybrid architectures combine the two approaches: reactive layers handle tight control loops, while deliberative layers provide goals, constraints, and re-planning. Hybrids remain the most practical template for agentic AI because they separate concerns: fast safety where the action is; slow reasoning in supervisory layers.

2.2 Belief–Desire–Intention (BDI) Architecture

BDI frames agency as the management of Beliefs (informational state), Desires (admissible goals), and Intentions (adopted plans/commitments). Two ideas make BDI enduring: commitment strategies (agents stick to intentions while conditions hold, creating predictability) and intention revision (when context changes, agents reconsider and may drop or replace intentions).

Mapping to modern GenAI agents is straightforward: Beliefs → world state and memory; Desires → goals and constraints; Intentions → active plans and tool calls. BDI clarifies where to place assurance: adoption filters decide when a goal becomes an intention; execution monitors track whether context still supports the intention; reconsideration policies specify how often and under what signals the agent re-plans.

3 A Taxonomy of Modern Agentic Architectures

Modern agentic systems are not single, monolithic designs, but compositions of different building blocks—planning loops, tool routers, memory layers, verifiers, and supervisors—typically stitched together around a core of generative reasoning.

Five families recur in practice:

3.1 Tool-Using Agents

Tool-using agents place a generative model in charge of deciding which external capabilities to invoke, with what arguments, and in what order, to accomplish a goal. A robust implementation separates three concerns: Planners generate intentional structure; Tool routers map abstract actions to concrete tools; Execution sandboxes perform pre-condition checks, rate-limit and permission each call, simulate where possible, and commit side-effects transactionally.

Key engineering choices: Typed schemas and validators; idempotent tools and request deduplication; capability-based permissioning; transactional semantics and compensations; budgets and termination criteria; deterministic observability.

3.2 Memory-Augmented Agents

Agentic systems become markedly more capable when they can remember. Working memory is a short-lived context (scratchpads, CoT traces); long-term memory splits into episodic stores (structured logs of prior tasks) and semantic stores (documents, facts). Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) provides a non-parametric pathway into semantic memory.

Designing memory for reliability requires: Provenance and attribution (every retrieved item should carry source identifiers, content hash, timestamp); Freshness and validity windows (time-to-live policies by source); Memory hygiene and poisoning defences (sanitise all untrusted text); Compaction, summarisation, and retention policies.

3.3 Planning and Self-Improvement Agents

Planning-centred agents strengthen reasoning with explicit search, external executors, and self-evaluation loops. Tree of Thoughts (ToT) organises inference as a search over intermediate thoughts; Graph of Thoughts (GoT) generalises to arbitrary dependency graphs; Program-Aided Language models (PAL) shift reasoning to executable programs; Reflexion adds self-evaluation and test-time repair without gradient updates.

3.4 Multi-Agent Systems

Multi-agent systems exchange a single "do-everything" agent for a team of specialised agents that co-operate under explicit protocols. Three topologies have emerged: Supervisor–worker (clear authority and escalation paths); Peer collaboration (protocol rules drive convergence); Role-specialised agents (auctions and blackboard systems).

The guiding principle across all patterns: models propose, architectures dispose—with contracts, governors, and sandboxes that convert open-ended reasoning into reliable action.

articles.title: 韩炳哲与数字时代的注意力贫困
articles.subtitle: 韩炳哲论算法时代的倦怠社会与注意力危机
articles.author: Byung-Chul Han / 政治哲学学者
articles.source: Zeit Online / 韩炳哲著作系列
articles.summary: 韩国-德国哲学家韩炳哲进一步论述了数字时代注意力贫困的深层机制：算法剥夺了人类深度专注的能力，使我们陷入一种新的精神贫困。

articles.content_cn:
韩炳哲是当代最具影响力的公共哲学家之一，他对数字时代注意力贫困的批判触及了现代人最深层的焦虑：在一个信息过载的世界中，我们正在失去专注、沉思和深度思考的能力。这位韩裔德国学者以一系列精炼的哲学随笔——《倦怠社会》《透明社会》《爱欲之死》——在全球思想界引起了广泛的共鸣。

韩炳哲哲学的核心是对当代社会「肯定性」范式的批判。在他看来，工业社会的统治基于「你应该」的超我命令，运作机制是负罪感和强制。而当代的成就社会则运行在「你可以」的积极鼓励之上，表面上是自由和解放，实际上制造了一种更隐蔽的自我剥削。主体不再是被迫劳动，而是自愿地将自己推向极限。这种从「你应该」到「你可以」的转变，并没有带来真正的自由，反而导致了普遍的倦怠、抑郁和焦虑。

在《倦怠社会》中，韩炳哲提出了一种新的病理学分类：抑郁症、注意力缺陷多动障碍、倦怠综合征和疲劳——这些都是「肯定性过量」的症状。当一切都变得可能和可获取时，当「不」被消除只剩下「是」时，人类精神就会崩溃。注意力贫困是这种肯定性过量的直接表现：当每时每刻都被刺激填满时，注意力就不再是我们可以自由支配的资源，而是被平台算法所捕获和利用的商品。

韩炳哲对数字技术和社交媒体的批判尤为深刻。他将社交媒体的「点赞」文化视为肯定性暴政的完美体现——一个没有否定性、没有摩擦、没有阻力的光滑世界。在这个世界中，他者被消解为同者的镜像，真正的相遇变得不可能。算法剥夺了人类深度专注的能力：推荐系统精确地为我们定制信息流，使我们在舒适的回音室中自满而不自知。我们以为自己看到了整个世界，实际上只是看到了算法认为我们想看的部分。

在政治层面，韩炳哲在《精神政治学》中分析了新自由主义权力如何通过数据收集、行为预测和情感管理来统治主体。不同于全景监狱式的外部监控，当代的权力运作从内部进行——它不需要强迫你做什么，只需要了解你的欲望和恐惧，然后在你自愿的数字行为中实现治理。这种「精神政治」比任何外部强制都更加有效，也更加难以抵抗。

重建深度注意力的能力需要刻意的努力和制度的支持。韩炳哲建议培养「无聊」的能力——在不被刺激填充的空白时间中让思想自然涌现。他呼吁重建深度阅读的习惯——不是浏览和扫描，而是缓慢地、反复地与一个文本对话。最重要的是，他提醒我们认识到真正的知识不是信息的累积，而是一种通过沉思、质疑和批判性思考而获得的深层理解。在信息泛滥的时代，保持思考的能力本身就是一种抵抗。

重建深度注意力的能力需要刻意的努力和制度的支持。韩炳哲建议培养「无聊」的能力——在不被刺激填充的空白时间中让思想自然涌现。他呼吁重建深度阅读的习惯——不是浏览和扫描，而是缓慢地、反复地与一个文本对话。最重要的是，他提醒我们认识到真正的知识不是信息的累积，而是一种通过沉思、质疑和批判性思考而获得的深层理解。在信息泛滥的时代，保持思考的能力本身就是一种抵抗。正如韩炳哲所言，真正的知识需要不透明——需要秘密、需要沉思的空间、需要不被立即消费的思考时间。

韩炳哲对「透明社会」的批判揭示了更深层的问题。当代文化将透明视为最高价值——一切都应该是可见的、可获取的、可测量的。但韩炳哲认为，真正的思想需要不透明——需要秘密、需要沉思的空间、需要不被立即消费的思考时间。当一切都被迫透明化时，深度思考本身就成为不可能。社交媒体上的「公开日记」文化、工作中的「全天候在线」期望、教育中的「学习分析」——这些看似进步的做法实际上在消灭思想生长所需的黑暗和安静。

在政治层面，韩炳哲在《精神政治学》中分析了新自由主义权力如何通过数据收集、行为预测和情感管理来统治主体。不同于全景监狱式的外部监控，当代的权力运作从内部进行——它不需要强迫你做什么，只需要了解你的欲望和恐惧，然后在你自愿的数字行为中实现治理。这种「精神政治」比任何外部强制都更加有效，也更加难以抵抗。当算法能够预测我们的行为、引导我们的注意力、塑造我们的欲望时，我们是否还有真正的自由意志？重建深度注意力不仅是个人的修行，更需要制度层面的变革——保护沉思空间、限制注意力掠夺、重新定义隐私和自主的价值。

韩炳哲对当代「肯定性」文化的分析在AI时代获得了新的意义。不同于工业社会以「你应该」的超我命令运作，当代成就社会以「你可以」的积极鼓励运行。这种表面上解放性的话语实际上制造了自我剥削的主体——我们自愿地在数字平台上消耗注意力、生产数据，误以为自己在自由选择，实际上是在参与一种更精细的控制。点赞文化是这种肯定性暴政的完美体现——一个没有否定性、没有摩擦、没有阻力的光滑世界。在这个世界中，他者被消解为同者的镜像，真正的相遇变得不可能。

对于如何在数字时代保持思考能力，韩炳哲提出了几个关键建议。培养「无聊」的能力——在不被刺激填充的空白时间中让思想自然涌现。重建深度阅读的习惯——不是浏览和扫描，而是缓慢地、反复地与一个文本对话。最重要的是，认识到真正的知识不是信息的累积，而是一种通过沉思、质疑和批判性思考而获得的深层理解。韩炳哲提醒我们，在一个一切都被透明化和数据化的社会中，真正的自由和思考能力需要不透明的空间——需要秘密、需要停顿、需要不被立即消费的思想时间。在信息泛滥的时代，学会不去检索——学会忍受不知道——可能是通向真正知识的第一步。韩炳哲的哲学为我们提供了一种在数字洪流中保持思想独立性的指南——不是拒绝技术，而是不让技术完全支配我们的精神生活。
articles.content_en:
Byung-Chul Han is one of the most influential public philosophers of our time. His critique of attention poverty in the digital age touches upon the deepest anxieties of modern people: in a world of information overload, we are losing the ability to focus, contemplate, and think deeply. This Korean-German scholar has resonated widely across the global intellectual community with a series of refined philosophical essays -- The Burnout Society, The Transparency Society, and The Agony of Eros.

At the core of Han's philosophy is his critique of the "affirmative" paradigm in contemporary society. In his view, the domination of industrial society was based on the superego command of "you should," operating through guilt and coercion. The contemporary achievement society, by contrast, runs on the positive encouragement of "you can" -- ostensibly about freedom and liberation, but actually producing a more insidious form of self-exploitation. The subject is no longer forced to labor but voluntarily pushes itself to the limit. This shift from "you should" to "you can" has not brought genuine freedom; instead, it has led to widespread burnout, depression, and anxiety.

In The Burnout Society, Han proposes a new pathological classification: depression, attention deficit hyperactivity disorder, burnout syndrome, and fatigue -- these are all symptoms of "excess positivity." When everything becomes possible and accessible, when "no" is eliminated and only "yes" remains, the human spirit collapses. Attention poverty is the direct manifestation of this excess positivity: when every moment is filled with stimuli, attention is no longer a resource we can freely dispose of, but a commodity captured and exploited by platform algorithms.

Han's critique of digital technology and social media is particularly incisive. He views the "like" culture of social media as the perfect embodiment of the tyranny of positivity -- a smooth world without negation, without friction, without resistance. In this world, the Other is dissolved into a mirror image of the Same, and genuine encounters become impossible. Algorithms strip away the human capacity for deep focus: recommendation systems precisely curate information feeds for us, leaving us complacent in comfortable echo chambers without our own awareness. We think we are seeing the whole world, but in reality we are only seeing what algorithms think we want to see.

At the political level, in Psychopolitics, Han analyzes how neoliberal power governs subjects through data collection, behavioral prediction, and emotional management. Unlike the panoptic-style external surveillance, contemporary power operates from within -- it does not need to force you to do anything; it only needs to understand your desires and fears, and then achieve governance through your voluntary digital behavior. This "psychopolitics" is more effective than any external coercion, and also far more difficult to resist.

Rebuilding the capacity for deep attention requires deliberate effort and institutional support. Han suggests cultivating the ability to be "bored" -- letting thoughts naturally emerge during blank time that is not filled with stimuli. He calls for rebuilding the habit of deep reading -- not browsing and scanning, but slowly and repeatedly engaging in dialogue with a text. Most importantly, he reminds us that genuine knowledge is not the accumulation of information, but a deep understanding acquired through contemplation, questioning, and critical thinking. In an age of information overload, maintaining the ability to think is itself a form of resistance.

Unlike the panoptic-style external surveillance, contemporary power operates from within -- it does not need to force you to do anything; it only needs to understand your desires and fears, and then achieve governance through your voluntary digital behavior. This "psychopolitics" is more effective than any external coercion, and also far more difficult to resist. When algorithms can predict our behavior, direct our attention, and shape our desires, do we still have genuine free will?

He calls for rebuilding the habit of deep reading -- not browsing and scanning, but slowly and repeatedly engaging in dialogue with a text. Most importantly, he reminds us that genuine knowledge is not the accumulation of information, but a deep understanding acquired through contemplation, questioning, and critical thinking. In an age of information overload, maintaining the ability to think is itself a form of resistance. As Han says, genuine knowledge requires opacity -- it needs secrets, spaces for contemplation, and thinking time that is not immediately consumed.

Han's critique of the "transparency society" reveals a deeper problem. Contemporary culture treats transparency as the highest value -- everything should be visible, accessible, and measurable. But Han argues that genuine thought requires opacity -- it needs secrets, spaces for contemplation, and time for thinking that is not immediately consumed. When everything is forced into transparency, deep thinking itself becomes impossible. The "public diary" culture on social media, the "always-on" expectation in the workplace, "learning analytics" in education -- these seemingly progressive practices are actually eliminating the darkness and quiet that thought needs to grow.

This "psychopolitics" is more effective than any external coercion, and also far more difficult to resist. When algorithms can predict our behavior, direct our attention, and shape our desires, do we still have genuine free will? Rebuilding deep attention is not only an individual practice but requires institutional change -- protecting spaces for contemplation, limiting attention predation, and redefining the value of privacy and autonomy.

Han's analysis of the contemporary "affirmative" culture takes on new significance in the AI era. Unlike industrial society, which operated through the superego command of "you should," the contemporary achievement society runs on the positive encouragement of "you can." This seemingly liberating discourse actually produces self-exploiting subjects -- we voluntarily consume attention and produce data on digital platforms, mistakenly believing we are making free choices, when in fact we are participating in a more refined form of control. The "like" culture is the perfect embodiment of this tyranny of positivity -- a smooth world without negation, without friction, without resistance. In this world, the Other is dissolved into a mirror image of the Same, and genuine encounters become impossible.

Regarding how to maintain the capacity for thinking in the digital age, Han offers several key suggestions. Cultivate the ability to be "bored" -- letting thoughts naturally emerge during blank time that is not filled with stimuli. Rebuild the habit of deep reading -- not browsing and scanning, but slowly and repeatedly engaging in dialogue with a text. Most importantly, recognize that genuine knowledge is not the accumulation of information, but a deep understanding acquired through contemplation, questioning, and critical thinking. Han reminds us that in a society where everything is being made transparent and datafied, genuine freedom and the capacity to think require opaque spaces -- secrets, pauses, and thinking time that is not immediately consumed. In an age of information overload, learning not to retrieve -- learning to endure not knowing -- may be the first step toward genuine knowledge. Han's philosophy provides us with a guide for maintaining intellectual independence amid the digital flood -- not by rejecting technology, but by not allowing technology to completely dominate our spiritual lives.

We think we are seeing the whole world, but in reality we are only seeing what algorithms think we want to see.

paragraphs.cn: 在政治层面，韩炳哲在《精神政治学》中分析了新自由主义权力如何通过数据收集、行为预测和情感管理来统治主体。不同于全景监狱式的外部监控，当代的权力运作从内部进行——它不需要强迫你做什么，只需要了解你的欲望和恐惧，然后在你自愿的数字行为中实现治理。这种「精神政治」比任何外部强制都更加有效，也更加难以抵抗。
paragraphs.en: At the political level, in Psychopolitics, Han analyzes how neoliberal power governs subjects through data collection, behavioral prediction, and emotional management. Unlike the panoptic-style external surveillance, contemporary power operates from within -- it does not need to force you to do anything; it only needs to understand your desires and fears, and then achieve governance through your voluntary digital behavior. This "psychopolitics" is more effective than any external coercion, and also far more difficult to resist.

paragraphs.cn: 重建深度注意力的能力需要刻意的努力和制度的支持。韩炳哲建议培养「无聊」的能力——在不被刺激填充的空白时间中让思想自然涌现。他呼吁重建深度阅读的习惯——不是浏览和扫描，而是缓慢地、反复地与一个文本对话。最重要的是，他提醒我们认识到真正的知识不是信息的累积，而是一种通过沉思、质疑和批判性思考而获得的深层理解。在信息泛滥的时代，保持思考的能力本身就是一种抵抗。
paragraphs.en: Rebuilding the capacity for deep attention requires deliberate effort and institutional support. Han suggests cultivating the ability to be "bored" -- letting thoughts naturally emerge during blank time that is not filled with stimuli. He calls for rebuilding the habit of deep reading -- not browsing and scanning, but slowly and repeatedly engaging in dialogue with a text. Most importantly, he reminds us that genuine knowledge is not the accumulation of information, but a deep understanding acquired through contemplation, questioning, and critical thinking. In an age of information overload, maintaining the ability to think is itself a form of resistance.

paragraphs.cn: 韩炳哲对数字技术和社交媒体的批判尤为深刻。他将社交媒体的「点赞」文化视为肯定性暴政的完美体现——一个没有否定性、没有摩擦、没有阻力的光滑世界。在这个世界中，他者被消解为同者的镜像，真正的相遇变得不可能。算法剥夺了人类深度专注的能力：推荐系统精确地为我们定制信息流，使我们在舒适的回音室中自满而不自知。我们以为自己看到了整个世界，实际上只是看到了算法认为我们想看的部分。
paragraphs.en: Han's critique of digital technology and social media is particularly incisive. He views the "like" culture of social media as the perfect embodiment of the tyranny of positivity -- a smooth world without negation, without friction, without resistance. In this world, the Other is dissolved into a mirror image of the Same, and genuine encounters become impossible. Algorithms strip away the human capacity for deep focus: recommendation systems precisely curate information feeds for us, leaving us complacent in comfortable echo chambers without our own awareness. We think we are seeing the whole world, but in reality we are only seeing what algorithms think we want to see.

paragraphs.cn: 在政治层面，韩炳哲在《精神政治学》中分析了新自由主义权力如何通过数据收集、行为预测和情感管理来统治主体。不同于全景监狱式的外部监控，当代的权力运作从内部进行——它不需要强迫你做什么，只需要了解你的欲望和恐惧，然后在你自愿的数字行为中实现治理。这种「精神政治」比任何外部强制都更加有效，也更加难以抵抗。当算法能够预测我们的行为、引导我们的注意力、塑造我们的欲望时，我们是否还有真正的自由意志？
paragraphs.en: At the political level, in Psychopolitics, Han analyzes how neoliberal power governs subjects through data collection, behavioral prediction, and emotional management. Unlike the panoptic-style external surveillance, contemporary power operates from within -- it does not need to force you to do anything; it only needs to understand your desires and fears, and then achieve governance through your voluntary digital behavior. This "psychopolitics" is more effective than any external coercion, and also far more difficult to resist. When algorithms can predict our behavior, direct our attention, and shape our desires, do we still have genuine free will?

paragraphs.cn: 重建深度注意力的能力需要刻意的努力和制度的支持。韩炳哲建议培养「无聊」的能力——在不被刺激填充的空白时间中让思想自然涌现。他呼吁重建深度阅读的习惯——不是浏览和扫描，而是缓慢地、反复地与一个文本对话。最重要的是，他提醒我们认识到真正的知识不是信息的累积，而是一种通过沉思、质疑和批判性思考而获得的深层理解。在信息泛滥的时代，保持思考的能力本身就是一种抵抗。正如韩炳哲所言，真正的知识需要不透明——需要秘密、需要沉思的空间、需要不被立即消费的思考时间。
paragraphs.en: Rebuilding the capacity for deep attention requires deliberate effort and institutional support. Han suggests cultivating the ability to be "bored" -- letting thoughts naturally emerge during blank time that is not filled with stimuli. He calls for rebuilding the habit of deep reading -- not browsing and scanning, but slowly and repeatedly engaging in dialogue with a text. Most importantly, he reminds us that genuine knowledge is not the accumulation of information, but a deep understanding acquired through contemplation, questioning, and critical thinking. In an age of information overload, maintaining the ability to think is itself a form of resistance. As Han says, genuine knowledge requires opacity -- it needs secrets, spaces for contemplation, and thinking time that is not immediately consumed.

paragraphs.cn: 韩炳哲对「透明社会」的批判揭示了更深层的问题。当代文化将透明视为最高价值——一切都应该是可见的、可获取的、可测量的。但韩炳哲认为，真正的思想需要不透明——需要秘密、需要沉思的空间、需要不被立即消费的思考时间。当一切都被迫透明化时，深度思考本身就成为不可能。社交媒体上的「公开日记」文化、工作中的「全天候在线」期望、教育中的「学习分析」——这些看似进步的做法实际上在消灭思想生长所需的黑暗和安静。
paragraphs.en: Han's critique of the "transparency society" reveals a deeper problem. Contemporary culture treats transparency as the highest value -- everything should be visible, accessible, and measurable. But Han argues that genuine thought requires opacity -- it needs secrets, spaces for contemplation, and time for thinking that is not immediately consumed. When everything is forced into transparency, deep thinking itself becomes impossible. The "public diary" culture on social media, the "always-on" expectation in the workplace, "learning analytics" in education -- these seemingly progressive practices are actually eliminating the darkness and quiet that thought needs to grow.

paragraphs.cn: 在政治层面，韩炳哲在《精神政治学》中分析了新自由主义权力如何通过数据收集、行为预测和情感管理来统治主体。不同于全景监狱式的外部监控，当代的权力运作从内部进行——它不需要强迫你做什么，只需要了解你的欲望和恐惧，然后在你自愿的数字行为中实现治理。这种「精神政治」比任何外部强制都更加有效，也更加难以抵抗。当算法能够预测我们的行为、引导我们的注意力、塑造我们的欲望时，我们是否还有真正的自由意志？重建深度注意力不仅是个人的修行，更需要制度层面的变革——保护沉思空间、限制注意力掠夺、重新定义隐私和自主的价值。
paragraphs.en: At the political level, in Psychopolitics, Han analyzes how neoliberal power governs subjects through data collection, behavioral prediction, and emotional management. Unlike the panoptic-style external surveillance, contemporary power operates from within -- it does not need to force you to do anything; it only needs to understand your desires and fears, and then achieve governance through your voluntary digital behavior. This "psychopolitics" is more effective than any external coercion, and also far more difficult to resist. When algorithms can predict our behavior, direct our attention, and shape our desires, do we still have genuine free will? Rebuilding deep attention is not only an individual practice but requires institutional change -- protecting spaces for contemplation, limiting attention predation, and redefining the value of privacy and autonomy.

paragraphs.cn: 韩炳哲对当代「肯定性」文化的分析在AI时代获得了新的意义。不同于工业社会以「你应该」的超我命令运作，当代成就社会以「你可以」的积极鼓励运行。这种表面上解放性的话语实际上制造了自我剥削的主体——我们自愿地在数字平台上消耗注意力、生产数据，误以为自己在自由选择，实际上是在参与一种更精细的控制。点赞文化是这种肯定性暴政的完美体现——一个没有否定性、没有摩擦、没有阻力的光滑世界。在这个世界中，他者被消解为同者的镜像，真正的相遇变得不可能。
paragraphs.en: Han's analysis of the contemporary "affirmative" culture takes on new significance in the AI era. Unlike industrial society, which operated through the superego command of "you should," the contemporary achievement society runs on the positive encouragement of "you can." This seemingly liberating discourse actually produces self-exploiting subjects -- we voluntarily consume attention and produce data on digital platforms, mistakenly believing we are making free choices, when in fact we are participating in a more refined form of control. The "like" culture is the perfect embodiment of this tyranny of positivity -- a smooth world without negation, without friction, without resistance. In this world, the Other is dissolved into a mirror image of the Same, and genuine encounters become impossible.

paragraphs.cn: 对于如何在数字时代保持思考能力，韩炳哲提出了几个关键建议。培养「无聊」的能力——在不被刺激填充的空白时间中让思想自然涌现。重建深度阅读的习惯——不是浏览和扫描，而是缓慢地、反复地与一个文本对话。最重要的是，认识到真正的知识不是信息的累积，而是一种通过沉思、质疑和批判性思考而获得的深层理解。韩炳哲提醒我们，在一个一切都被透明化和数据化的社会中，真正的自由和思考能力需要不透明的空间——需要秘密、需要停顿、需要不被立即消费的思想时间。在信息泛滥的时代，学会不去检索——学会忍受不知道——可能是通向真正知识的第一步。韩炳哲的哲学为我们提供了一种在数字洪流中保持思想独立性的指南——不是拒绝技术，而是不让技术完全支配我们的精神生活。
paragraphs.en: Regarding how to maintain the capacity for thinking in the digital age, Han offers several key suggestions. Cultivate the ability to be "bored" -- letting thoughts naturally emerge during blank time that is not filled with stimuli. Rebuild the habit of deep reading -- not browsing and scanning, but slowly and repeatedly engaging in dialogue with a text. Most importantly, recognize that genuine knowledge is not the accumulation of information, but a deep understanding acquired through contemplation, questioning, and critical thinking. Han reminds us that in a society where everything is being made transparent and datafied, genuine freedom and the capacity to think require opaque spaces -- secrets, pauses, and thinking time that is not immediately consumed. In an age of information overload, learning not to retrieve -- learning to endure not knowing -- may be the first step toward genuine knowledge. Han's philosophy provides us with a guide for maintaining intellectual independence amid the digital flood -- not by rejecting technology, but by not allowing technology to completely dominate our spiritual lives.

articles.summary: 2026年，开源大模型已从追随者转变为技术引领者。本文对比了Llama 4、Mistral-X及DeepSeek-V5等主流开源模型的架构创新与实际性能表现。

articles.content_cn:
大型语言模型架构对比：从 DeepSeek V3 到 Kimi K2
Sebastian Raschka 博士
最初的 GPT 架构开发至今已有七年。回顾 GPT-2（2019年）并展望 DeepSeek V3 和 Llama 4（2024-2025年），人们可能会惊讶地发现这些模型在结构上仍然非常相似。当然，位置嵌入已从绝对位置演变为旋转位置（RoPE），多头注意力在很大程度上已被分组查询注意力取代，更高效的 SwiGLU 已取代 GELU 等激活函数。但在这些微小改进之下，我们是看到了真正的突破性变化，还是只是在打磨相同的架构基础？
比较大型语言模型以确定有助于良好性能的关键因素是众所周知的挑战：数据集、训练技术和超参数差异很大，而且往往记录不全。然而，我认为检查架构本身的结构变化仍然很有价值，可以看到开发者们在 2025 年在做什么。
1. DeepSeek V3/R1
DeepSeek R1 于2025年1月发布时产生了重大影响。DeepSeek R1 是建立在 DeepSeek V3 架构之上的推理模型，该架构于2024年12月推出。这里重点介绍 DeepSeek V3 引入的两个关键架构技术：多头脑潜注意力（MLA）和混合专家（MoE）。
MLA：与分组查询注意力（GQA）不同——GQA 通过跨头共享键值投影来减少内存——MLA 在存储到 KV 缓存之前将键值张量压缩到更低维空间。在推理时，这些压缩张量被投影回原始大小。MLA 在建模性能方面优于 MHA，同时减少了内存使用。
MoE：DeepSeek V3 用多个专家层替换每个前馈模块，路由器仅选择每个令牌的一小部分专家。DeepSeek V3 每个 MoE 模块有 256 个专家，总共 6710 亿个参数，但每次仅 9 个专家处于活跃状态（1 个共享专家加 8 个路由器选择的专家），即每次推理步骤仅使用 370 亿个参数，而非全部 6710 亿。
一个值得注意的特点是共享专家的使用：一个对每个令牌始终处于活跃状态的专家。共享专家的好处是，共同或重复的模式不必由多个单独专家学习，这为学习更多专门化模式留出了更多空间。
DeepSeek V3 是一个巨大的 6710 亿参数模型，在发布时优于其他开放权重模型，包括 4050 亿参数的 Llama 3。尽管更大，但由于其 MoE 架构，在推理时效率更高。
2. OLMo 2
OLMo 系列由非营利组织 Allen Institute for AI 开发，因其在训练数据和代码方面的透明度而值得注意。OLMo 2 的有趣架构设计选择主要在于归一化：RMSNorm 层的放置以及 QK-norm 的添加。
大多数 LLM 使用 Pre-Norm（在注意力和前馈模块之前放置归一化）。OLMo 2 采用了一种 Post-Norm 形式（在之后放置），这有助于提高训练稳定性。QK-Norm 是在注意力模块内部应用于查询和键的 RMSNorm 层，在应用 RoPE 之前。Post-Norm 和 QK-Norm 共同稳定了训练损失。
3. Gemma 3
Gemma 3 使用滑动窗口注意力来降低计算成本。通过滑动窗口注意力，我们限制当前查询位置周围的上下文大小，显著减少 KV 缓存内存需求。Gemma 2 使用混合注意机制，以 1:1 的比例结合滑动窗口和全局注意力。Gemma 3 转变为 5:1 的比例：每 5 个滑动窗口（局部）注意力层只有 1 个完整注意力层，滑动窗口大小从 4096 减少到仅 1024 个令牌。
Gemma 3 还在注意力和前馈模块之前和之后都使用 RMSNorm 层——一种结合 Pre-Norm 和 Post-Norm 优点的混合方法。
4. Mistral Small 3.1
Mistral Small 3.1 于 3 月发布，在多个基准测试中优于 Gemma 3 27B，同时速度更快。较低推理延迟的原因可能是他们定制的分词器以及缩小 KV 缓存和层数。有趣的是，早期 Mistral 模型使用了滑动窗口注意力，但在 Mistral Small 3.1 中似乎已放弃，这可能是为了使用更多优化的 FlashAttention 代码。
5. Llama 4
Llama 4 也采用了 MoE 方法，整体架构与 DeepSeek V3 非常相似。Llama 4 Maverick 总参数 4000 亿，活跃参数 17B（2 个活跃专家，每个隐藏大小 8,096），而 DeepSeek V3 活跃参数 37B（9 个活跃专家，每个隐藏大小 2,048）。DeepSeek 在每个 transformer 块中使用 MoE 层（除前 3 个外），而 Llama 4 在每隔一个 transformer 块中交替使用 MoE 和密集模块。
6. Qwen3
Qwen3 提供 7 个密集模型：0.6B、1.7B、4B、8B、14B 和 32B；还有 2 个 MoE 模型：30B-A3B 和 235B-A22B。0.6B 模型可能是目前最小的当前代开源权重模型。Qwen3 内存占用更小，但使用比 Llama 3 更多的 transformer 块，导致运行时更慢但内存使用更低。
Qwen3 235B-A22B（22B 活跃参数）的架构与 DeepSeek V3 非常相似。但 Qwen3 不再使用共享专家（早期 Qwen 模型使用共享专家）。开发者指出："当时我们没有发现共享专家有足够显著的改进，而且担心共享专家带来的推理优化问题。"
7. SmolLM3
SmolLM3 以 30 亿参数的大小提供了良好的建模性能，最有趣的方面是使用 NoPE（无位置嵌入）。在 NoPE 中，根本不添加位置信号：不是固定的、不是学习的、也不是相对的。因果注意力掩码隐式保留自回归顺序。NoPE 论文发现，无需注入位置信息，而且 NoPE 具有更好的长度泛化能力。
8. Kimi K2
Kimi K2 最近引起轰动，因为它是一个开源权重模型，性能与 Gemini、Claude 和 ChatGPT 等最佳专有模型相当。一个值得注意的方面是使用 Muon 优化器而非 AdamW——据报道这是首次在任何这种规模的生产模型上使用 Muon。
关键结论：MoE 在 2025 年变得主导；MLA 优于 GQA 但实现更复杂；滑动窗口注意力在不损害性能的情况下减少内存；归一化放置（Pre vs Post）影响训练稳定性。该领域继续在相同核心架构基础上进行改进，而非革新。
articles.content_en:
The Big LLM Architecture Comparison: From DeepSeek V3 to Kimi K2
Sebastian Raschka, PhD
It has been seven years since the original GPT architecture was developed. At first glance, looking back at GPT-2 (2019) and forward to DeepSeek V3 and Llama 4 (2024-2025), one might be surprised at how structurally similar these models still are. Sure, positional embeddings have evolved, Multi-Head Attention has largely given way to Grouped-Query Attention, and SwiGLU has replaced activation functions like GELU. But beneath these refinements, have we truly seen groundbreaking changes, or are we simply polishing the same architectural foundations?
Comparing LLMs to determine the key ingredients that contribute to good performance is notoriously challenging: datasets, training techniques, and hyperparameters vary widely. However, examining the structural changes of the architectures themselves reveals what LLM developers are up to in 2025.
1. DeepSeek V3/R1
DeepSeek R1 made a big impact when released in January 2025. DeepSeek R1 is a reasoning model built on top of the DeepSeek V3 architecture, introduced in December 2024. Two key architectural techniques distinguish DeepSeek V3:
Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA): Unlike Grouped-Query Attention (GQA), which shares key and value projections across heads to reduce memory, MLA compresses key and value tensors into a lower-dimensional space before storing them in the KV cache. At inference time, these compressed tensors are projected back to their original size. MLA offers better modeling performance than MHA while reducing memory usage.
Mixture-of-Experts (MoE): DeepSeek V3 replaces each FeedForward module with multiple expert layers, where a router selects only a small subset of experts per token. DeepSeek V3 has 256 experts per MoE module and a total of 671 billion parameters, yet only 9 experts are active at a time (1 shared expert plus 8 selected by a router). This means just 37 billion parameters are used per inference step, not all 671 billion.
A notable feature is the shared expert: an expert that is always active for every token. Common or repeated patterns don't have to be learned by multiple individual experts, leaving more room for learning specialised patterns.
DeepSeek V3 is a massive 671-billion-parameter model that, at launch, outperformed other open-weight models including the 405B Llama 3. Despite being larger, it is much more efficient at inference time thanks to its MoE architecture.
2. OLMo 2
The OLMo series by the Allen Institute for AI is noteworthy due to its transparency in training data and code. OLMo 2's interesting architectural design choices come down to normalizations: the placement of RMSNorm layers and the addition of QK-norm.
Most LLMs use Pre-Norm (placing normalisation before attention and FeedForward modules). OLMo 2 adopted a form of Post-Norm (placing normalisation after), which helped with training stability.
QK-Norm is an RMSNorm layer placed inside the Multi-Head Attention module and applied to queries and keys before applying RoPE. Together with Post-Norm, QK-Norm stabilises the training loss.
3. Gemma 3
Gemma 3 uses sliding window attention to reduce computational costs. With sliding window attention, we restrict the context size around the current query position, substantially reducing KV cache memory requirements. The Gemma 2 predecessor used a hybrid attention mechanism combining sliding window and global attention in a 1:1 ratio. Gemma 3 shifts to a 5:1 ratio: there's only 1 full attention layer for every 5 sliding windows (local) attention layers, with the sliding window size reduced from 4096 to just 1024 tokens.
Gemma 3 also uses RMSNorm layers both before AND after the attention and FeedForward modules – a hybrid approach that gets the best of both Pre-Norm and Post-Norm.
4. Mistral Small 3.1
Mistral Small 3.1, released in March, outperforms Gemma 3 27B on several benchmarks while being faster. The reasons for lower inference latency are likely their custom tokenizer and shrinking the KV cache and layer count. Interestingly, earlier Mistral models had utilized sliding window attention but appear to have abandoned it in Mistral Small 3.1, possibly to use more optimised FlashAttention code.
5. Llama 4
Llama 4 has adopted an MoE approach and follows a relatively standard architecture very similar to DeepSeek V3. Llama 4 Maverick has 400 billion total parameters with 17B active parameters (2 active experts with 8,096 hidden size each), compared to DeepSeek V3's 37B active parameters (9 active experts with 2,048 hidden size each). DeepSeek uses MoE layers in each transformer block (except the first 3), whereas Llama 4 alternates MoE and dense modules every other block.
MoE architectures have seen a significant rise in popularity in 2025.
6. Qwen3
Qwen3 offers 7 dense models: 0.6B, 1.7B, 4B, 8B, 14B, and 32B; and 2 MoE models: 30B-A3B and 235B-A22B. The 0.6B model may well be the smallest current-generation open-weight model. Qwen3 has a smaller memory footprint but uses more transformer blocks than Llama 3, leading to slower runtime but lower memory usage.
In Qwen3 235B-A22B (22B active parameters), the architecture is remarkably similar to DeepSeek V3. However, Qwen3 moved away from using a shared expert (earlier Qwen models used shared experts). The developer noted: 'At that moment we did not find significant enough improvement on shared expert and we were worrying about the optimisation for inference caused by shared expert.'
7. SmolLM3
SmolLM3 offers good modelling performance at 3-billion parameter size. Its most interesting aspect is the use of NoPE (No Positional Embeddings). In NoPE, no positional signal is added at all: not fixed, not learned, not relative. The causal attention mask preserves autoregressive ordering implicitly. The NoPE paper found that no positional information injection is necessary and that NoPE has better length generalisation.
8. Kimi K2
Kimi K2 recently made big waves due to being an open-weight model with performance on par with the best proprietary models like Gemini, Claude, and ChatGPT. A notable aspect is its use of the Muon optimizer over AdamW – reportedly the first time Muon was used for any production model of this size. This resulted in very smooth and well-decaying training loss curves.
The key takeaway from this architectural survey is that MoE has become dominant in 2025, MLA outperforms GQA but is more complex to implement, sliding window attention reduces memory without hurting performance, and normalisation placement (Pre vs Post) affects training stability. paragraphs.cn:
大型语言模型架构对比：从 DeepSeek V3 到 Kimi K2
Sebastian Raschka 博士
最初的 GPT 架构开发至今已有七年。回顾 GPT-2（2019年）并展望 DeepSeek V3 和 Llama 4（2024-2025年），人们可能会惊讶地发现这些模型在结构上仍然非常相似。当然，位置嵌入已从绝对位置演变为旋转位置（RoPE），多头注意力在很大程度上已被分组查询注意力取代，更高效的 SwiGLU 已取代 GELU 等激活函数。但在这些微小改进之下，我们是看到了真正的突破性变化，还是只是在打磨相同的架构基础？
比较大型语言模型以确定有助于良好性能的关键因素是众所周知的挑战：数据集、训练技术和超参数差异很大，而且往往记录不全。然而，我认为检查架构本身的结构变化仍然很有价值，可以看到开发者们在 2025 年在做什么。
1. DeepSeek V3/R1
DeepSeek R1 于2025年1月发布时产生了重大影响。DeepSeek R1 是建立在 DeepSeek V3 架构之上的推理模型，该架构于2024年12月推出。这里重点介绍 DeepSeek V3 引入的两个关键架构技术：多头脑潜注意力（MLA）和混合专家（MoE）。
MLA：与分组查询注意力（GQA）不同——GQA 通过跨头共享键值投影来减少内存——MLA 在存储到 KV 缓存之前将键值张量压缩到更低维空间。在推理时，这些压缩张量被投影回原始大小。MLA 在建模性能方面优于 MHA，同时减少了内存使用。
MoE：DeepSeek V3 用多个专家层替换每个前馈模块，路由器仅选择每个令牌的一小部分专家。DeepSeek V3 每个 MoE 模块有 256 个专家，总共 6710 亿个参数，但每次仅 9 个专家处于活跃状态（1 个共享专家加 8 个路由器选择的专家），即每次推理步骤仅使用 370 亿个参数，而非全部 6710 亿。
一个值得注意的特点是共享专家的使用：一个对每个令牌始终处于活跃状态的专家。共享专家的好处是，共同或重复的模式不必由多个单独专家学习，这为学习更多专门化模式留出了更多空间。
DeepSeek V3 是一个巨大的 6710 亿参数模型，在发布时优于其他开放权重模型，包括 4050 亿参数的 Llama 3。尽管更大，但由于其 MoE 架构，在推理时效率更高。
2. OLMo 2
OLMo 系列由非营利组织 Allen Institute for AI 开发，因其在训练数据和代码方面的透明度而值得注意。OLMo 2 的有趣架构设计选择主要在于归一化：RMSNorm 层的放置以及 QK-norm 的添加。
大多数 LLM 使用 Pre-Norm（在注意力和前馈模块之前放置归一化）。OLMo 2 采用了一种 Post-Norm 形式（在之后放置），这有助于提高训练稳定性。QK-Norm 是在注意力模块内部应用于查询和键的 RMSNorm 层，在应用 RoPE 之前。Post-Norm 和 QK-Norm 共同稳定了训练损失。
3. Gemma 3
Gemma 3 使用滑动窗口注意力来降低计算成本。通过滑动窗口注意力，我们限制当前查询位置周围的上下文大小，显著减少 KV 缓存内存需求。Gemma 2 使用混合注意机制，以 1:1 的比例结合滑动窗口和全局注意力。Gemma 3 转变为 5:1 的比例：每 5 个滑动窗口（局部）注意力层只有 1 个完整注意力层，滑动窗口大小从 4096 减少到仅 1024 个令牌。
Gemma 3 还在注意力和前馈模块之前和之后都使用 RMSNorm 层——一种结合 Pre-Norm 和 Post-Norm 优点的混合方法。
4. Mistral Small 3.1
Mistral Small 3.1 于 3 月发布，在多个基准测试中优于 Gemma 3 27B，同时速度更快。较低推理延迟的原因可能是他们定制的分词器以及缩小 KV 缓存和层数。有趣的是，早期 Mistral 模型使用了滑动窗口注意力，但在 Mistral Small 3.1 中似乎已放弃，这可能是为了使用更多优化的 FlashAttention 代码。
5. Llama 4
Llama 4 也采用了 MoE 方法，整体架构与 DeepSeek V3 非常相似。Llama 4 Maverick 总参数 4000 亿，活跃参数 17B（2 个活跃专家，每个隐藏大小 8,096），而 DeepSeek V3 活跃参数 37B（9 个活跃专家，每个隐藏大小 2,048）。DeepSeek 在每个 transformer 块中使用 MoE 层（除前 3 个外），而 Llama 4 在每隔一个 transformer 块中交替使用 MoE 和密集模块。
6. Qwen3
Qwen3 提供 7 个密集模型：0.6B、1.7B、4B、8B、14B 和 32B；还有 2 个 MoE 模型：30B-A3B 和 235B-A22B。0.6B 模型可能是目前最小的当前代开源权重模型。Qwen3 内存占用更小，但使用比 Llama 3 更多的 transformer 块，导致运行时更慢但内存使用更低。
Qwen3 235B-A22B（22B 活跃参数）的架构与 DeepSeek V3 非常相似。但 Qwen3 不再使用共享专家（早期 Qwen 模型使用共享专家）。开发者指出："当时我们没有发现共享专家有足够显著的改进，而且担心共享专家带来的推理优化问题。"
7. SmolLM3
SmolLM3 以 30 亿参数的大小提供了良好的建模性能，最有趣的方面是使用 NoPE（无位置嵌入）。在 NoPE 中，根本不添加位置信号：不是固定的、不是学习的、也不是相对的。因果注意力掩码隐式保留自回归顺序。NoPE 论文发现，无需注入位置信息，而且 NoPE 具有更好的长度泛化能力。
8. Kimi K2
Kimi K2 最近引起轰动，因为它是一个开源权重模型，性能与 Gemini、Claude 和 ChatGPT 等最佳专有模型相当。一个值得注意的方面是使用 Muon 优化器而非 AdamW——据报道这是首次在任何这种规模的生产模型上使用 Muon。
关键结论：MoE 在 2025 年变得主导；MLA 优于 GQA 但实现更复杂；滑动窗口注意力在不损害性能的情况下减少内存；归一化放置（Pre vs Post）影响训练稳定性。该领域继续在相同核心架构基础上进行改进，而非革新。
paragraphs.en:
The Big LLM Architecture Comparison: From DeepSeek V3 to Kimi K2
Sebastian Raschka, PhD

It has been seven years since the original GPT architecture was developed. At first glance, looking back at GPT-2 (2019) and forward to DeepSeek V3 and Llama 4 (2024-2025), one might be surprised at how structurally similar these models still are. Sure, positional embeddings have evolved, Multi-Head Attention has largely given way to Grouped-Query Attention, and SwiGLU has replaced activation functions like GELU. But beneath these refinements, have we truly seen groundbreaking changes, or are we simply polishing the same architectural foundations?

Comparing LLMs to determine the key ingredients that contribute to good performance is notoriously challenging: datasets, training techniques, and hyperparameters vary widely. However, examining the structural changes of the architectures themselves reveals what LLM developers are up to in 2025.

1. DeepSeek V3/R1

DeepSeek R1 made a big impact when released in January 2025. DeepSeek R1 is a reasoning model built on top of the DeepSeek V3 architecture, introduced in December 2024. Two key architectural techniques distinguish DeepSeek V3:

Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA): Unlike Grouped-Query Attention (GQA), which shares key and value projections across heads to reduce memory, MLA compresses key and value tensors into a lower-dimensional space before storing them in the KV cache. At inference time, these compressed tensors are projected back to their original size. MLA offers better modeling performance than MHA while reducing memory usage.

Mixture-of-Experts (MoE): DeepSeek V3 replaces each FeedForward module with multiple expert layers, where a router selects only a small subset of experts per token. DeepSeek V3 has 256 experts per MoE module and a total of 671 billion parameters, yet only 9 experts are active at a time (1 shared expert plus 8 selected by a router). This means just 37 billion parameters are used per inference step, not all 671 billion.

A notable feature is the shared expert: an expert that is always active for every token. Common or repeated patterns don't have to be learned by multiple individual experts, leaving more room for learning specialised patterns.

DeepSeek V3 is a massive 671-billion-parameter model that, at launch, outperformed other open-weight models including the 405B Llama 3. Despite being larger, it is much more efficient at inference time thanks to its MoE architecture.

2. OLMo 2

The OLMo series by the Allen Institute for AI is noteworthy due to its transparency in training data and code. OLMo 2's interesting architectural design choices come down to normalizations: the placement of RMSNorm layers and the addition of QK-norm.

Most LLMs use Pre-Norm (placing normalisation before attention and FeedForward modules). OLMo 2 adopted a form of Post-Norm (placing normalisation after), which helped with training stability.

QK-Norm is an RMSNorm layer placed inside the Multi-Head Attention module and applied to queries and keys before applying RoPE. Together with Post-Norm, QK-Norm stabilises the training loss.

3. Gemma 3

Gemma 3 uses sliding window attention to reduce computational costs. With sliding window attention, we restrict the context size around the current query position, substantially reducing KV cache memory requirements. The Gemma 2 predecessor used a hybrid attention mechanism combining sliding window and global attention in a 1:1 ratio. Gemma 3 shifts to a 5:1 ratio: there's only 1 full attention layer for every 5 sliding windows (local) attention layers, with the sliding window size reduced from 4096 to just 1024 tokens.

Gemma 3 also uses RMSNorm layers both before AND after the attention and FeedForward modules – a hybrid approach that gets the best of both Pre-Norm and Post-Norm.

4. Mistral Small 3.1

Mistral Small 3.1, released in March, outperforms Gemma 3 27B on several benchmarks while being faster. The reasons for lower inference latency are likely their custom tokenizer and shrinking the KV cache and layer count. Interestingly, earlier Mistral models had utilized sliding window attention but appear to have abandoned it in Mistral Small 3.1, possibly to use more optimised FlashAttention code.

5. Llama 4

Llama 4 has adopted an MoE approach and follows a relatively standard architecture very similar to DeepSeek V3. Llama 4 Maverick has 400 billion total parameters with 17B active parameters (2 active experts with 8,096 hidden size each), compared to DeepSeek V3's 37B active parameters (9 active experts with 2,048 hidden size each). DeepSeek uses MoE layers in each transformer block (except the first 3), whereas Llama 4 alternates MoE and dense modules every other block.

MoE architectures have seen a significant rise in popularity in 2025.

6. Qwen3

Qwen3 offers 7 dense models: 0.6B, 1.7B, 4B, 8B, 14B, and 32B; and 2 MoE models: 30B-A3B and 235B-A22B. The 0.6B model may well be the smallest current-generation open-weight model. Qwen3 has a smaller memory footprint but uses more transformer blocks than Llama 3, leading to slower runtime but lower memory usage.

In Qwen3 235B-A22B (22B active parameters), the architecture is remarkably similar to DeepSeek V3. However, Qwen3 moved away from using a shared expert (earlier Qwen models used shared experts). The developer noted: 'At that moment we did not find significant enough improvement on shared expert and we were worrying about the optimisation for inference caused by shared expert.'

7. SmolLM3

SmolLM3 offers good modelling performance at 3-billion parameter size. Its most interesting aspect is the use of NoPE (No Positional Embeddings). In NoPE, no positional signal is added at all: not fixed, not learned, not relative. The causal attention mask preserves autoregressive ordering implicitly. The NoPE paper found that no positional information injection is necessary and that NoPE has better length generalisation.

8. Kimi K2

Kimi K2 recently made big waves due to being an open-weight model with performance on par with the best proprietary models like Gemini, Claude, and ChatGPT. A notable aspect is its use of the Muon optimizer over AdamW – reportedly the first time Muon was used for any production model of this size. This resulted in very smooth and well-decaying training loss curves.

The key takeaway from this architectural survey is that MoE has become dominant in 2025, MLA outperforms GQA but is more complex to implement, sliding window attention reduces memory without hurting performance, and normalisation placement (Pre vs Post) affects training stability. The field continues to refine the same core architectural foundations rather than revolutionising them.

articles.content_cn:
尼采的权力意志（Wille zur Macht）是他哲学体系中最核心也最容易被误解的概念之一。在算法主导一切的时代，重新审视这一概念不仅具有哲学意义，更直接关系到我们如何理解技术社会中权力的运作方式——以及我们如何在其中保持人的主体性。

权力意志不是对政治权力的简单追求，也不是达尔文式生存竞争的哲学化表达。在尼采的思想中，权力意志是存在的根本特征——一切有生命的事物都不仅在求生存，更在求超越、求增强。一棵树向上生长不仅是光合作用的生物过程，更是生命力的表达；一个学者追求真理不仅仅是实用需求，更是精神力量的展现。权力意志是对「更好」「更强」「更多」的内在驱动力，是生命肯定自身的方式。尼采以此来反对叔本华的「生存意志」——后者认为存在的本质是对生存的盲目追求，而尼采认为存在的本质是对力量增长的追求。仅仅生存是不够的，生命的价值在于超越自身。

尼采在《查拉图斯特拉如是说》中以最诗意的形式表达了这一思想：「生命本身就是权力意志。」这不是一个经验性的命题，而是一个本体论的断言——权力意志是存在的基本结构。这一思想使尼采预见了后来存在主义的核心关切：在上帝已死的时代，价值的创造不再是神圣启示的特权，而是人类自身权力意志的表达。超人理想——创造自己的价值、超越既定的规范——正是权力意志在伦理层面的最高体现。

在算法时代，权力意志获得了新的含义和紧迫性。算法系统的设计本质上体现了一种「求秩序」「求控制」的意志——将复杂的人类行为简化为可预测、可优化的数据流。这种技术性权力意志与尼采所警示的「最后的人」形成了呼应：一个一切都被安排、一切都被优化、一切风险都被消除的世界，恰恰是一个生命力衰退的世界。在算法定制一切的时代，人的偏好、选择和欲望都被预测和引导，真正的「权力意志」——超越既定模式、创造新价值的冲动——变得更加困难但也更加必要。

尼采的「重估一切价值」在今天意味着什么？在算法决定我们看什么新闻、买什么商品、与谁社交的时代，重估价值意味着追问：这些由算法优化的选择真的是我们自己的意志表达吗？我们是否被一种技术的权力意志所引导，误以为自己的偏好是自主的？当推荐算法比我们自己更了解我们的偏好时，「自主选择」还有意义吗？

对算法时代的权力意志分析提醒我们：真正的权力不是控制他人，而是控制控制本身——有能力选择不被算法定义、不被数据归类、不被优化逻辑所限制。在算法试图预测和塑造我们每一个行为的时代，尼采的哲学成为了一种抵抗的武器——提醒我们，人的本质不在于被计算，而在于超越。权力意志的最高表达不是适应系统，而是改变系统。

paragraphs.cn: 尼采的「重估一切价值」在今天意味着什么？在算法决定我们看什么新闻、买什么商品、与谁社交的时代，重估价值意味着追问：这些由算法优化的选择真的是我们自己的意志表达吗？我们是否被一种技术的权力意志所引导，误以为自己的偏好是自主的？当推荐算法比我们自己更了解我们的偏好时，「自主选择」还有意义吗？

paragraphs.cn: 对算法时代的权力意志分析提醒我们：真正的权力不是控制他人，而是控制控制本身——有能力选择不被算法定义、不被数据归类、不被优化逻辑所限制。在算法试图预测和塑造我们每一个行为的时代，尼采的哲学成为了一种抵抗的武器——提醒我们，人的本质不在于被计算，而在于超越。权力意志的最高表达不是适应系统，而是改变系统。

articles.title: DeepSeek-V4技术突破：开源大模型的中国范式

articles.summary: 深入解析DeepSeek-V4的技术突破，从MoE架构创新到强化学习优化，探索中国开源大模型如何重新定义AI研发的成本效益与性能边界

articles.content_cn:
DeepSeek-V4代表了开源大语言模型发展的一个重要里程碑。作为中国AI公司深度求索（DeepSeek）的最新力作，它在多个维度上挑战了闭源模型的统治地位，同时展示了开源AI的巨大潜力。这一模型的成功不仅是技术突破，更是对全球AI竞争格局的一次深刻重塑。

DeepSeek-V4的核心突破在于其创新的训练架构和效率优化。该模型采用了改进的混合专家（MoE）架构，总参数量达到万亿级别，但在推理时仅激活其中的一小部分专家模块。这种设计使模型在保持大参数规模优势的同时，将推理成本控制在与小得多的稠密模型相当的水平。据DeepSeek团队公布的信息，V4在代码生成、数学推理和多语言理解等关键能力上实现了显著提升，在多项基准测试中接近甚至超越了同期的闭源前沿模型。特别是在数学推理任务上，V4的表现在开源模型中名列前茅，展现出与OpenAI o3和Anthropic Claude 4相媲美的推理深度。

在训练效率方面，DeepSeek延续了V3时代的创新——以显著低于行业预期的成本训练出高性能模型。V3的训练成本仅约为550万美元，远低于GPT-4训练据估计的上亿美元。V4引入的Engram训练方法进一步降低了训练门槛，通过更高效的内存管理和计算调度，在性能相对有限的芯片上实现了高效的大模型训练。这一突破对于在全球芯片供应紧张背景下推动AI民主化具有深远意义——它证明了训练前沿AI模型不一定需要最先进的GPU集群。

DeepSeek-V4的开源策略是其影响力的重要组成部分。以开放权重发布意味着全球的开发者和研究者都可以基于V4进行二次开发和定制化训练，这为学术界和中小企业提供了与大型科技公司竞争的可能性。在代码生成领域，DeepSeek-V4表现尤为突出——内部测试显示其在处理超长代码提示和复杂编程任务上的能力已达到业界领先水平。该模型对中文的理解和生成能力也是其差异化优势之一——在中文场景下的写作质量、文化理解和语境把握都明显优于同期的英文为中心的开源模型。

展望未来，DeepSeek-V4的成功标志着开源AI生态正在从追赶者变为并行创新者。中国AI公司在开源大模型领域的持续投入和突破，正在改变全球AI竞争的格局——不再是少数几家美国公司的独角戏，而是一个多元化、多极化的创新生态。DeepSeek-V4的发布也对AI监管政策产生了影响——如何在促进开源创新的同时确保AI安全，成为各国政策制定者需要认真思考的问题。

articles.title: 量子机器学习2026：当量子计算遇见神经网络的交叉点
articles.subtitle: 量子计算与神经网络的交叉前沿
articles.author: Google Quantum AI / IBM Quantum Research
articles.summary: 探索量子机器学习的技术突破与应用前景，从量子神经网络到变分量子算法，了解量子计算如何为AI开启全新的计算范式
articles.content_en:
Quantum Machine Learning (QML) is a frontier field at the intersection of quantum computing and artificial intelligence that seeks to harness the properties of quantum mechanics to enhance machine learning algorithms. In 2026, QML is transitioning from theoretical exploration toward initial practical applications. While full quantum advantage has not yet been realized, progress across multiple directions is encouraging.

The core advantages that quantum computing brings to machine learning include quantum superposition and quantum entanglement. Superposition allows qubits to exist in multiple states simultaneously, enabling quantum computers to explore vast numbers of possible solutions in parallel -- a capability that is especially powerful for combinatorial optimization and search problems. Quantum entanglement provides a mechanism for establishing strong correlations between qubits, opening new possibilities for data representation and information processing. When these quantum properties are integrated into machine learning frameworks, they can theoretically achieve computational acceleration and pattern recognition capabilities that classical computing struggles to match. In particular, the inherently high dimensionality of quantum computing gives it a natural advantage in processing high-dimensional data.

Variational Quantum Circuits (VQC) are among the most commonly used architectures in QML today. They combine parameterized quantum circuits with classical optimization algorithms -- the quantum circuit handles feature mapping and computation in quantum state space, while the classical optimizer adjusts the parameters of the quantum circuit. This hybrid quantum-classical approach is the most practical choice in the current NISQ (Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum) era because it places relatively low demands on qubit count and quantum gate fidelity. Google's TensorFlow Quantum and IBM's Qiskit Machine Learning provide convenient QML development frameworks for researchers, lowering the barrier to entry.

In terms of specific applications, QML has shown promise in several directions. Quantum Support Vector Machines (QSVM) leverage quantum kernel methods for classification in high-dimensional feature spaces, demonstrating the potential to outperform classical SVMs on certain datasets -- particularly when the feature space dimensionality is extremely high. Quantum Generative Adversarial Networks (QGAN) may be more efficient than classical GANs at generating probability distributions, with direct applications in financial risk modeling. Quantum Reinforcement Learning (QRL) explores the possibility of quantum agents learning optimal policies in environments, with potential advantages in combinatorial optimization and scheduling problems. A notable advance in 2026 was the collaboration between IonQ and Ansys to run medical device simulations on a quantum computer, achieving approximately 12% speedup over classical methods.

However, the challenges facing QML remain formidable. The noise levels of current quantum computers limit the depth and width of quantum circuits, causing many theoretically feasible QML algorithms to underperform in practice. The quantum data loading problem -- efficiently encoding classical data into quantum states -- is another bottleneck that has not been fully resolved. Loading N data points may require O(N) quantum gate operations, negating the theoretical speedup of quantum algorithms. Furthermore, whether QML can achieve genuine "quantum advantage" over the best classical algorithms on real-world problems remains a subject of academic debate. Nevertheless, with continued improvements in quantum hardware and advances in quantum error correction, QML's potential as a bridge between quantum physics and artificial intelligence should not be overlooked.
articles.content_cn:
量子机器学习（Quantum Machine Learning, QML）是量子计算与人工智能交叉的前沿领域，它试图利用量子力学的特性来增强机器学习算法的能力。2026年，QML正在从理论探索走向初步的实际应用，虽然全面的量子优势尚未实现，但多个方向上的进展令人鼓舞。

量子计算为机器学习带来的核心优势包括量子叠加和量子纠缠。叠加态允许量子比特（qubit）同时处于多个状态，使量子计算机能够并行探索大量可能的解决方案——这种并行性在组合优化和搜索问题上尤为强大。量子纠缠则提供了一种在量子比特之间建立强关联的机制，为数据表征和信息处理开辟了新的可能性。当这些量子特性被整合到机器学习框架中时，理论上可以实现经典计算难以企及的计算加速和模式识别能力。特别是在高维数据的处理上，量子计算的内在高维性使其具有天然的优势。

变分量子电路（VQC）是当前QML最常用的架构之一。它将参数化的量子电路与经典的优化算法相结合——量子电路负责在量子态空间中进行特征映射和计算，经典优化器负责调整量子电路的参数。这种混合量子-经典的方法在当前NISQ（嘈杂中等规模量子）时代是最实际的选择，因为它对量子比特数量和量子门保真度的要求相对较低。Google的TensorFlow Quantum和IBM的Qiskit Machine Learning为研究者提供了便捷的QML开发框架，降低了进入门槛。

在具体应用方面，QML在几个方向上展现了前景。量子支持向量机（QSVM）利用量子核方法在高维特征空间中进行分类，在特定数据集上展现出超越经典SVM的潜力——特别是当特征空间维度极高时。量子生成对抗网络（QGAN）在生成概率分布方面可能比经典GAN更高效，在金融风险建模中有直接应用。量子强化学习（QRL）则探索了量子智能体在环境中学习最优策略的可能性，在组合优化和调度问题上有潜在优势。2026年的一个重要进展是IonQ和Ansys合作在量子计算机上运行医疗设备模拟，实现了比经典方法约12%的加速。

然而，QML面临的挑战依然严峻。当前量子计算机的噪声水平限制了量子电路的深度和宽度，使得许多理论上可行的QML算法在实践中表现不佳。量子数据加载问题——将经典数据高效地编码到量子态中——也是一个尚未完全解决的瓶颈，加载N个数据点可能需要O(N)的量子门操作，抵消了量子算法的理论加速。此外，关于QML是否能在实际问题实现真正的「量子优势」——即超越最优经典算法——学术界仍有争议。不过，随着量子硬件的持续改进和量子纠错技术的进步，QML作为连接量子物理与人工智能的桥梁，其发展潜力不容忽视。
